name: qwen36-35b-a3b-mi300x
description: Fallback: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (MoE, ~3B active parameters; hybrid Gated-DeltaNet + full attention) on one MI300X. Thinking is disabled through the chat template for training and serving.
model_notes: Verify the exact Hub repo id and licence on the model card.

Routed experts are fused 3-D tensors in transformers 5 (not nn.Linear): LoRA adapts full attention (q/k/v/o), the linear-attention projections (in_proj_qkv / in_proj_z / out_proj) and the shared-expert MLP; the detection summary reports how many fused expert tensors were skipped.
Serve with thinking disabled too: pass chat_template_kwargs {"enable_thinking": false} per request, or set a server-side default if your vLLM version supports one (check vllm serve --help).

estimates.status: ESTIMATES ONLY - replace with measured numbers during 12-18 Oct
estimates.memory: bf16 weights 35e9 x 2 B = ~70 GB; LoRA on attention + shared experts needs < 1 GB of optimizer state; activations at 2 x 8192 with checkpointing ~10-20 GB; expected peak ~90-110 GB. fp32 merge ~140 GB (fits).
estimates.wall_clock_per_epoch: ~10-40 min for ~6M tokens: only ~3B parameters are active per token (~1.1e17 FLOPs), but eager MoE routing in HF is far from peak; measure the first 20 steps before committing.
